audit: §7 dataset reproducibility (same seed, same configuration, two independent process invocations)

build_1.note: first build in this session; identity recorded before the second run

build_2.note: second, independent process invocation (also steps 1/4 of run_final_training.sh)

determinism_fixes.no_runtime_duration_in_corpus: src/tools/retrieval.py sorted(set(q_tokens)) (hash-order-independent float accumulation) + data_sources/synthetic_v3.py::_strip_volatile removes the runtime-measured duration_s before a result is serialized into a record; the mock envelopes used by the generators carry a constant 0.0001 so the training text is deterministic
determinism_fixes.deterministic_bm25: search scores accumulate over sorted(set(query_tokens)); ties break on source_id
determinism_fixes.deterministic_records: every generator consumes one seeded random.Random stream; no set iteration reaches a record

verification.claim: No runtime-measured value can reach the corpus text, so the corpus fingerprints identify content and not the machine that built it.

method.1_generator_literals: the mock envelope builders were executed and the timing literals they emit were read back: {'0.0001','0.0002','0.0004','0.0728','0.1199'}
method.2_corpus_scan: every duration_s occurrence in all four dataset_v9 splits was extracted and compared against that literal set
method.3_clock_injection: src.agent.tool_registry.time.monotonic was replaced by a clock that advances one hour per call; the envelope the generators splice into records was byte-identical, i.e. the runtime-measured duration is filtered out by data_sources/synthetic_v3.py::_strip_volatile
method.4_process_level: two fresh interpreters built the same envelopes and produced the same SHA-256; the whole-corpus version of this test is the second build compared above

verification.interpretation: duration_s appears only in tool_result context, never in a supervised target, and every value is a constant declared in the generator source. A real runtime duration at inference time is therefore a difference the model was never trained to predict.
verification.residual_difference_recorded: the mocked envelopes carry a constant duration_s while the runtime envelope strips the field entirely; the two shapes are compared field-by-field by the same test file so the divergence cannot grow silently
